gesture.title: Gesture
gesture.subtitle: Human Expression
gesture.modal_body: You draw a line with mouse or finger. AI analyses not the shape but biometric movement parameters: speed variability, pauses, corrections, rhythm irregularity. Bots move perfectly — humans don't.

ai.title: SapiX
ai.subtitle: Qwen3-14B
ai.modal_body: Qwen3-14B (via OpenRouter) receives only the statistical gesture vector — no coordinates, no personal data. Evaluates 8 parameters and returns: is_human, confidence (0–1), reasoning. Threshold: 85%.

did.title: DID:key
did.subtitle: W3C Standard
did.modal_body: An Ed25519 key pair is generated in the browser. The public key is encoded as did:key following the W3C standard. No servers, no registration — the key lives only in your browser's localStorage.

aptos.title: Aptos
aptos.subtitle: Blockchain
aptos.modal_body: The SHA3-256 hash of the proof (ExpressionProof) is written to a Move smart contract on Aptos. The hash contains no personal data — only gesture statistics, session_id and a 1-hour time bucket. Immutable and verifiable.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: Zero PII
privacy.modal_body: Raw coordinates are processed on-device only. Only the statistical vector (8 numbers) is sent to the server. Only the hash goes on-chain. No name, email, or IP is collected or stored.

bond.title: HSI Bond
bond.subtitle: Human Network
bond.modal_body: Verified humans can vouch for each other via HSI Bond. Each vouching strengthens the HumanCredential. Bots cannot receive vouching from real people — this is an additional layer of protection.

manifest.hero_subtitle: The internet was built by people — for people. It is time to protect that.
manifest.s1_p1: By 2025, most internet traffic is generated not by humans. Bots write comments, inflate votes, leave fake reviews, register thousands of accounts, and participate in surveys. The digital space has lost its defining property — it has stopped being human.
manifest.s1_p2: The problem is deeper than it seems. Existing solutions — CAPTCHA, SMS verification, KYC — are either easily bypassed or require identity disclosure. There is no open standard that allows proving humanity anonymously, without a passport or biometric scan.
manifest.s1_p3: Anyone can create a thousand accounts. Any bot can write that it is human. No service today can verify this claim — without intrusive surveillance or a centralised database.
manifest.s2_p1: APTOGON is not a replacement for the internet. It is a verification layer built on top — like HTTPS on top of HTTP. It adds one new primitive: HumanCredential — a cryptographically verified, on-chain proof that a living human is behind an action.
manifest.s2_p2: Verification is based on gesture biometrics, not identity. The system analyses movement statistics — speed variability, pause entropy, rhythm irregularity — without storing coordinates or shapes. This is what bots and AI agents cannot reliably imitate.
s2_steps: User draws a gesture — movement statistics processed on-device
Anonymous feature vector (no raw coordinates, no identity) sent to the backend
Result: is_human + confidence — zero personal data stored
On success, an Ed25519 DID is generated in the browser
SHA3-256 hash of the proof written to Aptos blockchain (on-chain HumanCredential)

apps.title: Market Research
apps.desc: One DID = one respondent. Duplicate submissions, click farms, and incentive hunters are eliminated at the source. On-chain proof makes every dataset auditable.

apps.title: Communities & Platforms
apps.desc: Ban evaders return in seconds with a new email. A device-bound DID actually bans the human — not just the account. Voting, ratings, and moderation work again.

apps.title: AI Data Labeling
apps.desc: One person with 50 annotator accounts can poison an entire training dataset. APTOGON ties each annotator to a physical device, making sybil attacks mathematically expensive.

apps.title: DAO & Web3 Governance
apps.desc: One human, one vote. No Sybil attacks, no wallet farms capturing governance. APTOGON is the only provider with a real on-chain HumanCredential on Aptos.

apps.title: Chats & Comments
apps.desc: A Verified Human badge appears for real people. Discussion quality changes instantly — not through censorship, but through trust in the source.

apps.title: Education & Certification
apps.desc: The exam was passed by a human, not an AI. An online diploma has meaning when there is proof of who earned it — without storing a government ID.

manifest.s4_p1: APTOGON exists as an open protocol with a transparent pay-per-verification model. Verifying your own humanity is always free — this is a principle. Platforms pay for verifying their users.
manifest.s4_p2: Platforms pay for verifying their users — just as they now pay for reCAPTCHA and fraud detection, but more honestly, transparently, and without sharing data with third parties. No setup fee, no minimum contract. Enterprise and white-label available on request.
manifest.s5_p1: Early adopters are communities already hurting from bots: developers, DAO members, market researchers, forum moderators, AI labeling platforms. For them, verification is not a barrier — it is a privilege.
manifest.s5_p2: The Verified Human badge isn't a blue checkmark you can buy — it's a green one that can't be bought, faked, or transferred. It proves not fame — but existence.
manifest.s5_p3: APTOGON Chat is the first live deployment — a real-time human-only space with rooms, DMs, and file sharing. The bond/vouch graph lets verified members strengthen the trust of others. Four verticals are live: Market Research, Communities, AI Data Labeling, and Web3/DAOs.
manifest.quote: "The internet must remember that humans are behind it. APTOGON is the cryptographic proof of that."

solutions_gonka.title: What is Gonka — and why APTOGON runs on it
solutions_gonka.subtitle: The decentralized AI network that analyzes every gesture on APTOGON — and half of our own name.
solutions_gonka.nameBody: APTOGON is a portmanteau: Aptos — the blockchain where every HumanCredential is anchored — plus Gonka — the decentralized AI network that classifies every gesture. Two decentralized layers, one product name.
solutions_gonka.missionBody: Today's AI inference runs almost entirely through four companies — OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Meta. That concentration creates real risk for any product that depends on it: a single company can raise prices unilaterally, restrict access by region, or go down entirely and take every dependent service offline with it. Export restrictions on advanced GPUs also mean entire countries can be physically locked out of AI compute, regardless of ability to pay. Gonka routes inference across thousands of independently-operated GPUs instead of one company's data centers — no single entity can price us out, cut us off, or shut us down.
missionBullets: Pricing set by a market, not one company
No single company's outage can take verification with it
Works the same regardless of export-control geography

howItems.title: ML-nodes
howItems.desc: GPU-equipped servers run inference for whichever request the network assigns them.

howItems.title: Transfer Agents
howItems.desc: Intermediary nodes route each request to available compute, wherever it is.

howItems.title: Sprint Consensus
howItems.desc: The network confirms which computation actually happened, in real time, while serving requests.

howItems.title: Proof of Computation
howItems.desc: A slice of every request is independently re-computed by a different node to catch dishonest results.

solutions_gonka.securityTitle: Why we trust it with something that matters
securityBullets: Cryptographic signatures verify each computation in under 10 milliseconds.
A node caught cheating loses a share of its staked collateral — a real financial cost for dishonesty.
The network is fully open-source and has been independently audited (CertiK).
solutions_gonka.costBody: Gonka's inference cost runs at a small fraction of a centralized provider's list price for comparable models, because no single company's margin is baked into every request. That matters for APTOGON specifically: gesture verification has to run at scale, for free-tier users, without our costs scaling in lockstep with a Big Tech price list we don't control.
solutions_gonka.closing: This is also, not coincidentally, the same principle behind APTOGON's own architecture: zero-PII, on-chain proof, no single company holding the keys to whether you can prove you're human.
